title: 无菌操作与细胞培养
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/178_无菌操作与细胞培养.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/178_无菌操作与细胞培养/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，手拿一只空白培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet in a clean microbiology teaching lab, holding up an empty petri dish, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十六课：无菌操作与细胞培养。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着敞开的平板边说边划，旁边的酒精瓶靠着火焰
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks loudly while streaking an open petri dish next to a burner flame, a spray bottle of alcohol sitting right beside the flame, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰边聊边划线，酒精瓶就挨着火。

shots.scene: 三天后，他的平板长满了杂菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a petri dish covered with fuzzy mixed colonies of many colors instead of neat separate dots, a sad face icon. No text.
shots.narration: 三天后，平板长满了杂菌。

shots.scene: 小研：污染挡在外面，火也要管住
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and gloves points to a tidy bench with a burner and a capped alcohol bottle kept far away.
shots.narration: 小研：无菌靠规范，明火要管住。

shots.scene: 空气、台面、手上都有微生物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny microbe icons floating in the air, sitting on a bench surface, on hands and on a plant leaf. No text.
shots.narration: 空气、台面、手上，到处是微生物。

shots.scene: 无菌操作：不让杂菌混进来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield around an open culture dish blocking microbe icons from the air, only the target microbe inside. No text.
shots.narration: 无菌操作：营造无菌环境，只留目标菌。

shots.scene: 培养基营养好，杂菌也爱长
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nutrient medium plate feeding both a young plant tissue and unwanted bacteria and mold, the unwanted ones growing faster. No text.
shots.narration: 培养基营养好，杂菌长得更快。

shots.scene: 杂菌吃掉细胞，整瓶报废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a culture flask with healthy cells being overrun by contaminating microbes, then the flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 污染会毁掉细胞，整批报废。

shots.scene: 灭菌消毒只能尽量降低风险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk bar going down step by step with cleaning, disinfection and careful handling icons, never quite reaching zero. No text.
shots.narration: 做不到绝对无菌，只能步步降风险。

shots.scene: 进实验室前先参加准入培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a training certificate card to the young male student at a microbiology lab door. The card is blank.
shots.narration: 进微生物室、细胞室，先过准入培训。

shots.scene: 评估菌株和细胞的危害，定防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strain tube and a cell flask under a magnifier, a risk matrix and a protection level ladder beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 评估菌株、细胞的风险，定防护级别。

shots.scene: 教学用菌株，领用归还登记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a labeled teaching strain tube on a tray, a logbook with a check mark, an unknown soil sample crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只用批准的教学菌株，领还要登记。

shots.scene: 细胞可能带病毒，先查SDS
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cell flask with a small virus warning icon, and a safety data sheet document with a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 细胞可能带病毒，试剂先查SDS。

shots.scene: 扎发、穿实验服、戴护目镜手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back long hair, buttons a lab coat, puts on safety goggles and gloves that cover the wrists.
shots.narration: 扎好头发，穿实验服，戴手套护目镜。

shots.scene: 【实拍】七步洗手，洗掉细菌和皮屑
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands being washed thoroughly with soap at a lab sink, rubbing palms, backs of hands and between fingers.
shots.narration: 接触细胞前，先认真洗手。

shots.scene: 不用嘴吸液，用移液器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mouth pipetting icon crossed out, a hand holding a pipette controller checked. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不用嘴吸液，一律用移液器。

shots.scene: 开工前擦台面、扫地、关窗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes a lab bench, a closed window and a blocked air vent icon in the background, a broom leaning by the wall.
shots.narration: 开工前擦台面，关好门窗避开风口。

shots.scene: 喷消毒剂，用纸巾擦拭
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands spraying disinfectant on a bench and wiping with a paper towel, the towel then dropped into a waste bag.
shots.narration: 台面喷消毒剂，纸巾擦净按规定丢。

shots.scene: 柜内台面用前用后各擦一遍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety cabinet work surface being wiped with a spray bottle, a before icon and an after icon both checked. No text.
shots.narration: 用乙醇擦柜内台面，用前用后各一遍。

shots.scene: 活组织不能高压，靠消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plant tissue piece next to an autoclave crossed out, and a disinfectant spray bottle checked. No text.
shots.narration: 活组织不能高压灭菌，只能靠消毒。

shots.scene: 超净台护样品，生物安全柜护人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean bench with airflow blowing toward the user marked for non-hazardous work, and a biological safety cabinet protecting user and sample. No text.
shots.narration: 超净台只做无害材料，有风险进安全柜。

shots.scene: 前窗放在规定的低位
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the front sash of a biological safety cabinet lowered to its marked working height, a green check beside it.
shots.narration: 安全柜前窗放到规定高度。

shots.scene: 共用操作台：带走自己的东西
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shared transfer hood with two students taking turns, one carrying away their own dishes, tools soaking in a disinfectant jar. No text.
shots.narration: 共用操作台，用完带走自己的培养物。

shots.scene: 再进柜，先消毒手套和台面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands being sprayed with disinfectant before reentering a cabinet, the surface lightly sprayed again.
shots.narration: 再进柜，先给手套和台面消毒。

shots.scene: 物品擦拭后再放进柜
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands wiping the outside of a medium bottle with disinfectant before placing it inside a safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 进柜的每样东西，先擦一遍。

shots.scene: 一次放齐，定位摆放，不堆满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a top view of a cabinet work surface with only a few items in fixed places, a crowded surface beside it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一次放齐，定位摆放，台面别堆满。

shots.scene: 移液器放右边，试剂放中后
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a top view layout with a pipette controller on the right and reagent bottles in the middle back, arrows showing no reaching over. No text.
shots.narration: 顺手布局，手不从敞口瓶上方跨。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手直进直出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved arms moving straight into and out of a safety cabinet front opening, slowly, without sweeping sideways.
shots.narration: 双手直进直出，不在柜口横扫。

shots.scene: 动作慢、少说话
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slow motion icon, a closed mouth icon and a calm hand over a dish, a talking mouth icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 动作慢而稳，操作时少说话。

shots.scene: 火焰周围落菌少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burner flame with rising warm air pushing microbe icons away from a small working zone around it. No text.
shots.narration: 火焰周围的空气，落菌少得多。

shots.scene: 先划火柴，再开燃气点火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, a lit match, a closed air hole on the burner barrel, the gas valve opening, then a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 先划火柴，关进气孔，再开气点火。

shots.scene: 暂不用火，调成黄色火焰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burner with a visible yellow flame and an arm moving around it carefully, a hidden blue flame icon with a caution mark. No text.
shots.narration: 暂时不用，调成看得见的黄焰。

shots.scene: 关灯：先关进气孔，再关燃气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, the air hole closing to a yellow flame, then the gas valve turned off, the flame gone, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 关灯：先关进气孔，再关燃气阀。

shots.scene: 酒精灯：火柴点，灯帽盖灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol lamp lit with a match and put out with its cap, lighting one lamp from another crossed out, blowing it out crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 酒精灯用火柴点、灯帽盖，不能对点。

shots.scene: 明火旁喷酒精，雾气着火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol spray mist drifting into a burner flame and catching fire, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有明火时，绝不能喷酒精。

shots.scene: 等酒精挥发干再点火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet bench surface drying with evaporation icons, a clock, then a burner being lit, checked. No text.
shots.narration: 擦过酒精，等它挥发干再点火。

shots.scene: 酒精瓶远离火焰，少量存放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small capped alcohol bottle placed far from a burner flame, a big bottle next to the flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 酒精瓶少量、盖好、远离火焰。

shots.scene: 安全柜里不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a biological safety cabinet with a flame icon crossed out inside, an electric loop sterilizer and disposable loops checked. No text.
shots.narration: 安全柜里不用明火，用电热灭菌器。

shots.scene: 小火用灭火毯盖，报告老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small bench fire covered with a fire blanket, then a person reporting to a teacher, a gas valve closed icon. No text.
shots.narration: 小火用灭火毯盖，关气，报告老师。

shots.scene: 火焰调蓝，环和环杆都烧红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire inoculating loop held in a blue burner flame, the loop and wire glowing red along the whole length. No text.
shots.narration: 调成蓝焰，环和环杆都烧到发红。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先烤环杆，环由内向外加热
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a clean wire loop slowly drawn through a blue flame from the handle end toward the loop tip until it glows.
shots.narration: 先烤环杆，再由内向外慢慢加热。

shots.scene: 带菌环直接进火会溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loop with liquid plunged straight into the hottest part of a flame, tiny droplets spattering out, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带菌环直接插进火心，会溅出菌液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】火焰旁停几秒，轻触琼脂检验
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hot wire loop held near the flame for a few seconds, then gently touching the edge of a sterile agar plate.
shots.narration: 停几秒冷却，触琼脂没嗞嗞声再取菌。

shots.scene: 用完再烧，放灯座旁冷却
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a used loop flamed again and rested on a holder beside the burner, away from paper and people. No text.
shots.narration: 用完再烧一遍，放稳冷却别碰人。

shots.scene: 写培养基、姓名、菌名、日期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bottom of a petri dish with four blank label lines around its edge, a marker pen beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 划线前先标记：培养基、姓名、菌名、日期。

shots.scene: 【实拍】写在皿底边缘
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand writing small blank marks along the rim of the bottom of an upside down petri dish with a marker.
shots.narration: 写在皿底，沿边环写，不挡菌落。

shots.scene: 平板划线：转接和分离菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube and a broth flask pointing to a fresh agar plate, single separate dots appearing on it. No text.
shots.narration: 平板划线法，用来转接和分离菌。

shots.scene: 分四区，越划越稀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate divided into four zones, dense lines in zone one, fewer in two and three, a few single dots in zone four. No text.
shots.narration: 分四个区，一区接一区，越划越稀。

shots.scene: 一个细胞长成一个菌落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one single cell icon growing into one round colony, a zoom circle on zone four. No text.
shots.narration: 一个活细胞长成一个菌落，就是单菌落。

shots.scene: 第四区：平行线或竖线加蛇形
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two options for the last zone, parallel lines not touching zone three, or one straight line followed by a snake line to the center. No text.
shots.narration: 第四区可划平行线，或竖线加蛇形线。

shots.scene: 挑一个单菌落，平板翻正
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sterile loop picking one small colony from a source plate, a new plate turned face up. No text.
shots.narration: 挑一个单菌落，平板翻正再划。

shots.scene: 【实拍】第一区轻轻来回划
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand lifting a petri dish lid slightly and lightly zigzagging a loop across the first zone of a sterile agar plate.
shots.narration: 第一区来回轻划，别划破琼脂。

shots.scene: 盖回皿盖，再灼烧接种环
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid placed back on the plate immediately, then the loop going back into the flame. No text.
shots.narration: 马上盖盖，再灼烧接种环。

shots.scene: 【实拍】转动平板，与上一区相交划
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the plate rotated a quarter turn and the cooled loop drawing separate strokes that cross into the first zone.
shots.narration: 转动平板，与上一区相交，每道抬起。

shots.scene: 每区：烧、冷、触、交
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repeating cycle of four icons, flame, cooling, touching agar, crossing lines, around a plate with zones three and four. No text.
shots.narration: 每区都：灼烧、冷却、检验、相交。

shots.scene: 对光看划痕
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finished plate held up against a lamp, faint streak lines visible on the agar surface, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 对光能看到划痕，说明划到了。

shots.scene: 肉汤轻摇匀，新平板标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capped broth culture tube being gently swirled, a new labeled plate beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 肉汤先轻摇匀，新平板同样标记。

shots.scene: 【实拍】小指夹瓶盖，瓶口过火
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand loosening a tube cap with the little finger and holding it, the tube mouth passed briefly through a flame.
shots.narration: 小指夹住瓶盖，瓶口过一下火。

shots.scene: 伸环取液，瓶口再过火盖好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sterile loop dipped into the broth showing a thin liquid film, the tube mouth flamed again and capped. No text.
shots.narration: 伸环取液见液膜，瓶口再过火盖好。

shots.scene: 环杆伸进瓶里，也要烧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long loop wire reaching deep into a bottle, the whole wire highlighted for flaming. No text.
shots.narration: 环杆伸进瓶里，所以也要烧到。

shots.scene: 只在第一区加一次菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inoculum added only to zone one, a second dip back into the broth crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只在第一区加一次菌，不回瓶补菌。

shots.scene: 平板倒置培养
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate turned upside down in an incubator, condensation drops on the lid kept away from the agar. No text.
shots.narration: 平板倒过来放，冷凝水不滴下。

shots.scene: 捆好放进指定培养盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two inverted plates held together with a rubber band, placed into a designated incubator box. No text.
shots.narration: 两块平板捆好，放进指定培养盒。

shots.scene: 核心：只用无菌物接触无菌物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sterile pipette touching sterile medium checked, a pipette touching a bottle outside crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 核心原则：只用无菌的东西碰它们。

shots.scene: 【实拍】拆移液管，只握上端
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands peeling open a sterile pipette wrapper, touching only the top end and inserting it into a pipette controller.
shots.narration: 拆移液管，只握上端插进移液器。

shots.scene: 培养基只在柜里开盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a medium bottle opened inside a cabinet checked, the same bottle opened on an open bench crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 培养基和试剂，只在柜内打开。

shots.scene: 【实拍】瓶盖口朝下放，尽快盖回
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand placing a bottle cap opening side down on the cabinet surface, without touching the inner rim.
shots.narration: 手不碰盖内沿，盖口朝下放。

shots.scene: 一支移液管只用一次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one pipette used once and discarded, the same pipette dipped into a second bottle crossed out, a pipette left standing in a bottle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一支移液管只用一次，碰脏就换。

shots.scene: 加完添加剂，摇匀标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supplement added to a medium bottle, the bottle gently swirled, a blank label with a pen icon. No text.
shots.narration: 加完添加剂摇匀，标明加了什么和时间。

shots.scene: 大体积首选移液管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large pipette transferring medium checked, pouring from bottle to bottle shown faded with a biohazard caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 大量转移首选移液管，有生物危害不倾倒。

shots.scene: 洒出立即擦净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small spill on the cabinet surface wiped immediately with a disinfectant soaked towel. No text.
shots.narration: 洒出来的液体，立刻用消毒剂擦净。

shots.scene: 传代换液，原则相同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cell flask being passaged and fed inside the cabinet, the same rule icons repeated, no reaching over open flasks. No text.
shots.narration: 传代换液原则一样，干脆利落。

shots.scene: 瓶子拧紧再拿出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bottles capped tightly before leaving the cabinet, a bottle opened outside the cabinet marked not for culture. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶子拧紧再拿出，柜外开过的不再用。

shots.scene: 台面再消毒，纸巾按感染性废物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the work surface sprayed and wiped again, used towels dropped into a biohazard waste bag. No text.
shots.narration: 台面再消毒，纸巾进感染性废物袋。

shots.scene: 摘手套、洗手，实验服不出门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes gloves into a waste bag, washes hands, and hangs his lab coat on a hook before leaving.
shots.narration: 摘手套洗手，实验服留在实验室。

shots.scene: 发现污染：不开盖，不闻
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a contaminated dish with a fuzzy growth, an opening hand icon and a nose icon both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 发现污染皿：不开盖、不闻、不细看。

shots.scene: 立即报告老师，取出高压灭菌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator, then the sealed contaminated dish goes into an autoclave bag.
shots.narration: 立即报告，取出后高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 噬菌体实验专区专用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separated work zone with its own tools for phage work, an arrow to a neighbor's bacterial plates crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 噬菌体极易串染，专区专用器材。

shots.scene: 菌液洒了：盖纸巾、倒消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small culture spill covered with paper towels and disinfectant poured from the edge inward, a timer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 菌液洒了：盖上纸巾，从外向内倒消毒剂。

shots.scene: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲洗并报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand rinsed at a sink and an eye at an eyewash station, then a report arrow to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤眼睛，立即冲洗并报告。

shots.scene: 准入、防护、清洁、柜内操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a training card, goggles and gloves, a spray bottle and a safety cabinet, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 准入防护、清洁台面、规范进柜。

shots.scene: 灼烧冷却、四区划线、倒置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing loop, a four zone streak plate and an inverted plate in an incubator. No text.
shots.narration: 灼烧冷却，四区划线，倒置培养。

shots.scene: 酒精远离火，污染不开盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol bottle away from a flame, a sealed contaminated dish going to an autoclave. No text.
shots.narration: 酒精远离明火，污染皿灭菌处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一瓶小小的植物组培苗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small glass culture jar with a tiny green plantlet growing on medium, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：植物组织培养。
